Class CausesCodec

java.lang.Object
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.core.CausesCodec
public final class CausesCodec extends Object
The wire representation of a causal frontier.

The format is frozen: entries grouped by topic, structural fields as minimal varints, positions fixed-width (wire-format.md, D98). Any change to the grammar requires a new FORMAT_VERSION and a documented migration, because a frontier written by one process is read by another.

Decoding is strict: a header that is truncated, miscounted, negatively positioned, out of canonical order or padded in its varints is rejected rather than salvaged. Metadata that cannot be trusted is treated as a reason to stop, so a corrupted frontier cannot silently become a weaker one.

  • Method Details

    • encode

      public static byte[] encode(Causes causes)
      Encodes a frontier.

      Channels are written in ChannelId order — topics ascending unsigned, each once, partitions ascending within their group — so the same frontier always yields the same bytes.

      Parameters:
      causes - the frontier to encode
      Returns:
      the header value

    • decode

      public static Causes decode(byte[] headerValue) throws CausesCodec.UndecodableMetadataException
      Decodes a frontier.
      Parameters:
      headerValue - the header value, which may be null
      Returns:
      the frontier
      Throws:
      CausesCodec.UndecodableMetadataException - if the value is null, carries an unknown version, is truncated, miscounts its groups or pairs, names a negative position, the reserved zero topic ID or a topic with zero partitions, lists topics or partitions out of strictly ascending order, or spells a varint non-minimally or beyond the non-negative int range
